Interface MysteryCellDestination

All Known Implementing Classes:
AlphaDestination, ApproachDestination, BaseDestination, BetaDestination, EntryDestination, GammaDestination, TrackDestination
public interface MysteryCellDestination
One place to which a Mystery Cell can send pieces (T-11). Each destination knows what happens when the pieces arrive: for example Alpha gives an effect, Beta restricts the pieces and Gamma reverses their direction.

      void receive(Player player, List<Piece> teleportedPieces, GameMessagePublisher messagePublisher)

      Parameters:
      player - the owner of the pieces
